title: Ski Chantecler
specs: Identification required for equipment rental (driver’s license, RAMQ card, or credit card)
Parent or guardian signature required if renter is under 18 years old
Introductory course for children over 6 years old
Family rental package requires minimum 3 members of same family, same address, including at least 1 parent and child 17 or under
Friends rental package requires 3 or more adults
includes: Equipment rental includes skis, boots, poles, helmet or board, boots, helmet
Introductory course includes equipment rental and daily ticket
gap: Prices for ski school lessons not stated
blurb: Guests can rent complete ski or snowboard equipment including skis or board, boots, poles, and helmet. The ski school offers introductory courses for children over 6 years old, private lessons, and seasonal programs. The resort provides a boutique at the foot of the slopes for gear and accessories.
extraNote: Deposit required for snowmobile rental helmet · Introductory course strongly suggested for snowmobile novices · Boutique at the foot of the slopes
